extracted.intended_audience: U.S. patent examiners, patent attorneys, agents, and applicants (patent practitioners)
extracted.subtask_description: Table of contents for the United States Patent and Trademark Office Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP). Covers procedural, substantive, and administrative topics governing U.S. patent prosecution and examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change Summary
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary of recent revisions and changes to the manual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title Page
rubrics_metrics.description: Front matter identifying the manual and its revision date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreword
rubrics_metrics.description: Prefatory material describing the scope, purpose, or authority of the manual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Introductory material outlining the manual's organization and use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secrecy, Access, National Security, and Foreign Filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies and procedures concerning secrecy orders, access restrictions, national-security considerations, and requirements/approvals related to foreign filing of patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types and Status of Application; Benefit and Priority Claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for different application types (e.g., provisional, nonprovisional, continuation, divisional), application status, and rules for asserting benefit and priority claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ownership and Assignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures for establishing and recording ownership, assignments, and related conveyances affecting patent rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representative of Applicant or Owner
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and criteria governing representation before the Office, including power of attorney, practitioner qualifications, and appointment/recognition of representatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Receipt and Handling of Mail and Papers
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for receipt, handling, and processing of correspondence, papers, and other submissions to the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parts, Form, and Content of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements governing the required parts of an application (specification, claims, drawings, oath/decl.), formatting, and substantive content requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards, procedures, and criteria used during substantive examination of patent applications, including search and rejection practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restriction in Applications Filed Under 35 U.S.C. 111; Double Patenting
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on restriction practice under 35 U.S.C. 121/ 111 and analysis/handling of double patenting issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Art, Classification, and Search
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles and procedures for determining relevant prior art, classification of inventions, and conducting searches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Matters Decided by Various U.S. Patent and Trademark Office Officials
rubrics_metrics.description: Topics describing authorities, decision-making responsibilities, and actions of various USPTO officials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutory Invention Registration (SIR); Pre-Grant Publication (PGPub) and Preissuance Submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and procedures for SIRs, pre-grant publication of applications, and third-party preissuance submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures, standards, and practice for appealing examiner decisions to the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) and related appellate matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowance and Issue
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures for allowance, issue, and the steps leading to grant of a patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Mechanisms and standards for correcting patents (reissue, reexamination, certificate of correction, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Design Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific rules and examination criteria applicable to design patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plant Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific rules and examination criteria applicable to plant patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Miscellaneous
rubrics_metrics.description: Collection of topics and procedures that do not fall neatly into other chapters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on PCT applications, international filing, and related Office procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protest
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for submitting and considering protests against patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and obligations regarding duty of candor and disclosure of information (e.g., 37 C.F.R. 1.56 / duty to disclose material information).

rubrics_metrics.name: Patentability
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive criteria for patentability, including novelty, non-obviousness, statutory subject matter, and related analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citation of Prior Art and Ex Parte Reexamination of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for citation of prior art against patents and for initiating and conducting ex parte reexamination proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interference and Derivation Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for adjudicating inventorship and priority disputes, including interference and derivation practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biotechnology
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized examination guidance and policies related to biotechnology inventions and disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintenance Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules, timing, and procedures for payment and collection of patent maintenance fees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optional Inter Partes Reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for optional inter partes reexamination proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Terms, Adjustments, and Extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing patent term calculation, statutory adjustments, and extensions (e.g., for regulatory delays).

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and purposes of supplemental examination to consider information affecting patent validity.

rubrics_metrics.name: International Design Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on international filing and prosecution of design applications (Madrid/Hague or other regimes as applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: Form Paragraphs Consolidated (FPC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Collection of standardized form paragraphs used in Office correspondence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix I: [Reserved]
rubrics_metrics.description: Reserved appendix slot (no substantive content indicated).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix II: List of Decisions Cited
rubrics_metrics.description: Compilation of judicial and administrative decisions cited throughout the manual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix L: Patent Laws
rubrics_metrics.description: Text or compilation of statutory patent law provisions referenced by the manual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix R: Patent Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Citation and text of the Patent Rules (37 C.F.R. part 1 and related rules) relevant to prosecution and practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix T: Patent Cooperation Treaty and Regulations Under the PCT
rubrics_metrics.description: Text and regulatory materials pertaining to the PCT and its implementing regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix AI: Administrative Instructions Under the PCT
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative instructions and Office practice notes for handling PCT matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix P: Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.description: Text and guidance on the Paris Convention provisions relevant to priority and international filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index (Subject Matter Index)
rubrics_metrics.description: Subject-matter index for locating topics within the manual.
